WITH equipment_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    equipref,
    AVG(humepct) as avg_humidity
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY equipref
),

overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) as overall_average
  FROM equipment_avgs
),

above_avg_equipment AS (
  SELECT ea.equipref, ea.avg_humidity
  FROM equipment_avgs ea
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE oa.overall_average IS NOT NULL
    AND ea.avg_humidity > oa.overall_average
),

kept_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) as kept_avg
  FROM above_avg_equipment
)

SELECT 
  ae.equipref,
  ae.avg_humidity,
  ae.avg_humidity - oa.overall_average as exceeds_overall,
  ABS(ae.avg_humidity - km.kept_avg) as distance_from_kept_mean
FROM above_avg_equipment ae
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
CROSS JOIN kept_mean km
WHERE oa.overall_average IS NOT NULL
  AND km.kept_avg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY distance_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
